---
title: "Stores"
description: "Every remote store this site reads, how permanent it is, and whether it answered at the last build."
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
from _common import *
import pandas as pd
```

The registry is [`docs/stores.yml`](https://github.com/hypertidy/gdalxarray/blob/main/docs/stores.yml).
Before each build `scripts/check_stores.py` opens every store with
GDAL (metadata only) and records the result; pages use that record to
decide whether to run their remote cells. A weekly scheduled build
fails if a store marked *pinned* or *permanent* stops answering.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print("\n".join(f"- **{k}**: {v.split(': ', 1)[-1]}" for k, v in PERMANENCE.items()))
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
rows = []
for s in STORES.values():
    st = STATUS.get(s["key"], {})
    miss = missing_capabilities(s["key"])
    if not s.get("used_in"):
        state = "not used"
    elif miss:
        state = "needs " + ", ".join(miss)
    elif st.get("ok"):
        state = "live"
    elif st:
        state = "down: " + st.get("error", "")[:60]
    else:
        state = "not checked"
    rows.append({
        "store": s["title"],
        "permanence": s.get("permanence", "unknown") + (" (to confirm)" if s.get("confirm") else ""),
        "provider": s.get("provider", ""),
        "last check": state,
        "checked": st.get("checked", ""),
        "pages": ", ".join(u.replace(".qmd", "") for u in s.get("used_in", [])),
    })
pd.DataFrame(rows).style.hide(axis="index")
```

## Addresses

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for s in STORES.values():
    print(f"**{s['title']}**  ")
    print(f"`{s['dsn']}`  ")
    if s.get("note"):
        print(f"{s['note']}  ")
    if s.get("source"):
        print(f"Also referenced in: {s['source']}  ")
    print()
```

## Fixtures

The [Guide](guide/index.qmd) uses no remote stores except GitHub: its
inputs are [wxylib/fixtures](https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures) at a
pinned commit, fetched once per build.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
print(f"Pinned commit: [`{FIXTURES_SHA[:10]}`](https://github.com/wxylib/fixtures/tree/{FIXTURES_SHA}).")
```
